description: This file defines various classes and functions for different ingestion components in a data processing pipeline, including base classes, single-threaded, batch, parallel, and pipeline ingestion strategies, with detailed handling of threading, multiprocessing, and index management.

classes.name: BaseIngestComponent
classes.description: Abstract base class for ingestion components, defining the interface for ingesting, bulk ingesting, and deleting documents.

classes.name: BaseIngestComponentWithIndex
classes.description: Extends BaseIngestComponent, manages index initialization, saving, and deletion with thread safety.

classes.name: SimpleIngestComponent
classes.description: Implements a straightforward ingestion process, transforming files into documents and saving them into the index.

classes.name: BatchIngestComponent
classes.description: Handles batch processing of files with multiprocessing for reading and parsing, optimizing batch embeddings.

classes.name: ParallelizedIngestComponent
classes.description: Parallelizes file ingestion, reading, embedding, and index insertion using multiprocessing and threading.

classes.name: PipelineIngestComponent
classes.description: Implements a threaded pipeline for ingestion, with queues and multiple threads for reading, processing, and indexing documents.

methods.name: get_ingestion_component
methods.description: Factory function to select and instantiate the appropriate ingestion component based on settings.
